_README.description: MiniMax via its OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, MINIMAX_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.minimax.io/v1. M3 weights are open but 428B, so the API is the practical route. Scores pinned to the minimax/* OpenRouter mirrors where a paid mirror exists. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash (2026-10-19) - multimodal MoE (text and image input, 1M context) for agentic coding; thinking is always on. Direct MiniMax API, $0.15/$0.60 per M. AA Intelligence Index 43 (AA lists one row; MiniMax's default effort is max, so the score at the high-effort anchor may be a little high). OpenRouter offers only a free, rate-limited endpoint so far, so there is no OpenRouter entry.
